pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of secondary entries within 30 minutes of a prior position on the same asset to eliminate correlated drawdowns.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: ATR-based volatility ceiling: Reject all entries if the current 5-minute candle range exceeds 2.5x the 20-period average true range.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing or partial harvest whenever open profit crosses +$12.00 to guarantee asymmetric +$15 to +$30 runs.
